relationships.subject: TRPA1 promoter methylation
relationships.evidence_quote: our results suggest that hypermethylation and increased pain sensitivity could be connected, possibly due to the variation of TRPA1 expression

relationships.subject: bradykinin
relationships.evidence_quote: TRPV1 can be modulated by bradykinin via prostaglandin receptor E2 (EP4)

key_findings: Meta-analysis of six clinical studies found no significant difference in TRPA1 methylation between chronic pain patients and controls (high heterogeneity).
TRPA1 hypermethylation tends to correlate with higher pain sensitivity.
